info.name: SMC Trade License - Local
info.description:
Trade license flows against the local stack started by `start-local.ps1` (see LOCAL_RUN.md).

Run the requests of a folder top to bottom, or run the whole folder with the Collection Runner.
Each update request first reads the application with `_search`, changes the action and sends it back; that happens in the collection pre-request script, driven by the `X-TL-*` headers of the request:

- `X-TL-User`: `citizen`, `tlsu1` (real employee TLSU1 with its real roles) or `employee` (made-up employee with the role in `X-TL-Role`)
- `X-TL-Action`: workflow action to send; `X-TL-From`: status to wait for before sending
- `X-TL-Expect`: status the test expects afterwards

There is no gateway locally: `authToken` is not checked and `userInfo` is sent in the body. The built body of the last update is visible in the Postman console.
The database is shared with the deployed environment: every run creates real records.

exec: citizen: { id: Number(v('citizenId')), uuid: v('citizenUuid'), userName: v('citizenMobile'), name: 'OWNER', mobileNumber: v('citizenMobile'), type: 'CITIZEN', tenantId: v('stateTenantId'),
tlsu1:   { id: Number(v('tlsu1Id')), uuid: v('tlsu1Uuid'), userName: 'TLSU1', name: 'TLSU1', type: 'EMPLOYEE', tenantId: tenant,
roles: v('tlsu1Roles').split(',').map(r => ({ code: r.trim(), name: r.trim(), tenantId: tenant })) }
// "employee": a made-up employee holding exactly the role named in X-TL-Role
userInfo = { id: 1, uuid: 'local-test-employee', userName: 'LOCALEMP', name: 'Local Test Employee', mobileNumber: '9999999999', type: 'EMPLOYEE', tenantId: tenant,
roles: [{ code: role, name: role, tenantId: tenant }] };
const requestInfo = { apiId: 'Rainmaker', authToken: 'not-checked-locally', msgId: 'postman|en_IN', userInfo };
// read the application; the persister writes a few seconds after each call, so retry
body: { mode: 'raw', raw: JSON.stringify({ RequestInfo: requestInfo }) } }, (err, res) => {
try { license = res.json().Licenses[0]; } catch (e) { /* not there yet */ }
if (!license) throw new Error('Application ' + v('applicationNumber') + ' not found. Run the create request first.');
// the persister update mapping blanks addressLine1 unless it is sent every time
license.tradeLicenseDetail.applicationDocuments = types.map(t => ({ tenantId: tenant, documentType: t, fileStoreId: 'local-test-' + t.toLowerCase(), active: true }));
pm.variables.set('updateBody', JSON.stringify({ RequestInfo: requestInfo, Licenses: [license] }, null, 2));
try { body = pm.response.json(); } catch (e) { /* not json */ }
console.log(pm.info.requestName + ' -> ' + license.applicationNumber + ' is ' + license.status + (license.licenseNumber ? ', license ' + license.licenseNumber : ''));

request.description: Saves a draft application. Stores applicationNumber for the following requests.
Reads the application back. The persister writes it a few seconds after the create call.
Submits the draft. Adds propertyId, owner Aadhaar and address, and the required documents. All SMC checks run here.
Needs role TL_DOC_VERIFIER.
Needs role TL_FIELD_INSPECTOR.
Needs role TL_HOD. No user in pg.smc holds this role yet, so it is always sent as a made-up employee.
Needs role TL_APPROVER. The fee is calculated and the demand is created here.
billing-service generates the bill for the demand created at APPROVE. Saves billId and billAmount for the payment.
collection-services creates the payment and receipt and publishes the payment event. billing-service then marks the demand paid and tl-services approves the license.
Waits until the payment event is processed, then shows status APPROVED with the license number.

item.name: Negative: FORWARD with the wrong role

request.description: TL_HOD tries the document verifier step. Must be refused with INVALID ROLE.
By TL_DOC_VERIFIER. Result: CITIZENACTIONREQUIRED.
By the citizen. Result: APPLIED.
By TL_DOC_VERIFIER. Result: FIELDINSPECTION.
By TL_FIELD_INSPECTOR, one step back. Result: APPLIED.
By TL_DOC_VERIFIER. Result: REJECTED, which ends the application.
